overall.verdict: A visually disciplined, genuinely informative dark wallet whose green/violet money-semantics, co-signed framing and proof surfaces build real trust, on par with a strong beta rather than a shipping product. It is held back by heavy protocol machinery leaking into simple flows (collateral sliders in faucets and receive), one near-illegible destructive screen (dispute overlay), duplicated inconsistent money vocabulary across screens, and layout dead zones that signal unfinishedness.
priority_fixes: Rebuild the dispute overlay as a high-contrast opaque modal with legible 3-step consequences and a guarded destructive CTA (06b) — this is the trust-critical path
Extract 'Prepare to receive / credit extension' from Receive, Swap-cross and Faucet into one reusable advanced flow invoked only when capacity is missing (04, 05b, 12)

Unify the money vocabulary and totals: one set of terms (on-chain / reserve / collateral / promised) with identical labels and a consistent composition breakdown across home, manage, account and sovereignty (01, 11, 06, 15)
Fix truncation and overlap defects: desk table credit columns, sovereignty counterparty card text collision, swap-cross tooltip overlap (16, 15, 05b)
Make settlement state machine legible in lists: swap rows show both legs (USDC → WETH), reconcile activity counts, add copy affordances on proofs (07, 08)
